criteria.text: The participant has a clinically suspected or histologically confirmed solid or hematological malignancy and has undergone or will undergo genetic testing of their tumor.
The participant has failed first-line therapy for their disease (refractory) or has no options for curative therapies.
The participant has either measurable or non-measurable disease.
The participant is ≥18 years of age.
The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status ≤3.

If the participant has brain metastasis, treatment of their brain metastasis must have been completed at least 1 day prior to enrollment, and they must be on a stable dose of steroids or off steroids at the time of enrollment.
The participant has the ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document.

The participant has had chemotherapy or radiotherapy within 3 weeks (6 weeks for nitrosoureas or mitomycin C) prior to entering the study, or has not recovered from adverse events due to agents administered more than 3 weeks earlier.

The participant has an uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, ongoing or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia, or psychiatric illness/social situations that would limit compliance with targeted therapy, in the opinion of the treating physician.
The participant is a pregnant woman.
The participant is HIV positive with a CD4 count below 500, or is not on a stable dose of antiretroviral therapy (for at least 1 month prior to registration).

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Evaluating Genomic Testing in Human Cancer & Outcomes of Targeted Therapies". Your earlier answers already covered 4 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you had, or do you plan to have, genetic testing done on your tumor?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't rightly know. I'm not sure if they did that kind of testing on my tumor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have cancer that your doctor has identified as either measurable (visible on scans) or non-measurable?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't rightly know if they can measure it. I'm not sure about that.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 61 years old.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you willing to sign a written document that explains the study details and gives your permission to participate?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I suppose so, if it's what's needed to get this treatment. I want to try to get better.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you feel comfortable that you can understand the study details well enough to make an informed decision?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I suppose so. I can understand what they're telling me, even if it takes me a little while to process it all.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you received chemotherapy or radiation therapy in the last 3 weeks (or 6 weeks for certain specific drugs)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I finished my radiation to the chest three months ago. I haven't had any chemo or radiation since then.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To help us check eligibility, do you currently have any active infections, heart issues (like chest pain or fluid in the lungs), or other serious medical conditions that your doctor feels might make it hard to follow the study treatment plan?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I've got hepatitis C that hasn't been treated, and my lung got inflamed from the radiation before, though it's better now. I haven't had any heart trouble or other serious issues lately.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Regarding your hepatitis C, has your doctor said it is currently uncontrolled or active?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I have hepatitis C. I haven't had it treated.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are you currently pregnant?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, sir, I'm a man.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
